title: Mo FemJobPayload v0 (Q3)
description: POST /jobs payload when jobType=fem. Align with docs/drafts/Q3-调度与FEM边界.md, Q4plus-5-磁静力学与轴向真值.md, and openapi-v1.yaml. Q5-2: equationMode heat_proxy|magnetostatic; heat-proxy ≠ magnetostatic.

projectId.description: Optional echo of Job.projectId for worker-side checks

operatingPoint.description: Inline operating point object or { "$ref": "..." } into .mems / project

materials.description: Material refs aligned with Q2 materials API / .mems materials/

templateId.description: Optional id under packages/solver-fem/templates/. af_pmsm_3d_ms implies equationMode=magnetostatic when equationMode omitted.

equationMode.description: Q5-2 equation mode. Missing + dryRun=false → heat_proxy compat. templateId af_pmsm_3d_ms implies magnetostatic when omitted.

dryRun.description: Optional dry-run flag; worker gate remains MO_FEM_DRY_RUN.
